name: Can I clean up sewage backup in my bathtub myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I clean up sewage backup in my bathtub myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attempting to clean up sewage backup yourself is not recommended due to significant health risks. Sewage water, classified as category 3 or 'black water,' contains dangerous contaminants like bacteria, viruses, and fungi. Exposure can lead to serious illnesses. Professionals have specialized equipment, protective gear, and disinfectants to safely and effectively remove sewage, decontaminate the affected areas, and prevent mold growth. Hiring experts ensures a thorough and safe restoration process.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, it is not recommended to clean up sewage yourself due to severe health risks from contaminants. Professionals have the right equipment and training to do it safely.
